scope: synthetic live-engine tool continuation and read-only index lifecycle audit
conclusions: Host-backed adoption and short tool continuation succeeded for this synthetic input above the physical Device pool capacity.
Index extent from the longer context persisted in an unrelated short request, reproducing a lifecycle gap.
The source uses a process-global mean-K index, zeroed at installation, with accumulating appends and no continuation binding or restore.
The test did not demonstrate physical KV page loss or establish which defect caused the original task to replan.
limitations: One synthetic sequence of five requests, no real browser and no image pixels.
Outputs were short; this is not a long-generation pressure test or a full 256K qualification.
Correct output codes do not establish that every requested page was restored or that the index arithmetic is correct.
No original private task replay, raw user sessions, generated reasoning, credentials or private configuration are included.
No engine repair or universal quality/performance improvement is claimed.
